page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8te.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for high-performance computing workloads. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 6462C processors running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

For acceleration, the instance includes four NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPUs with a combined total of 192 GB of VRAM. This hardware configuration is deployed on a KVM hypervisor and does not include any local storage, requiring external storage solutions. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

Given the high density of GPU resources and system memory, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring parallel processing capabilities without the overhead of local storage maintenance. It is suitable for deep learning, graphics rendering, scientific simulations, and large-scale data processing tasks.
